Acquisition / Email delivery and engagement

Delivered-email click-through rate

The percentage of successfully delivered recipient-message pairs recording at least one eligible content-link click. Each pair contributes once, even when the recipient clicks several links or clicks repeatedly.

Explore in the metric hierarchy ↗Open calculators →
Level 4Inspect the detail

The percentage of successfully delivered recipient-message pairs recording at least one eligible content-link click. Each pair contributes once, even when the recipient clicks several links or clicks repeatedly.

%

How we use it

We compare content, offers, and calls to action, then connect clicks to useful downstream actions.

Transparent calculationDelivered recipient-message pairs with at least one eligible click / successfully delivered recipient-message pairs in the same campaign window * 100
unique clicked recipient messages240
delivered recipient messages4,800

240 / 4,800 * 100 = 5% delivered-email CTR.

Illustrative calculation. Not a client result or a universal benchmark.

Break the result down

  • Campaign and content variant
  • Recipient segment
  • Eligible link and device

Questions we investigate

  • Which offers attract relevant clicks?
  • Are security scanners generating apparent activity?
  • Do clicks progress to the intended action?

Actions the evidence supports

  • Compare consistent content-link classifications.
  • Test clear, relevant calls to action.
  • Validate landing-page and conversion tracking.

Reporting contract

Ownership & cadence

Email marketing lead
After the agreed campaign click window.

Required data

  • Delivered recipient-message identifiers
  • Unique eligible click events
  • Bot-filter and link classification policy

Read the measure with context

Zero deliveries makes the rate undefined. This differs from total clicks and click-to-open rate. Document bot filtering, redirect tracking, link exclusions, and the observation window; privacy tools can distort click measurement.
